title: SOC2 evidence + vendor review - daily scratchpad
body:
Quick context:
- Running down remaining SOC2 evidence for security config + vendor supply chain. Mostly low-risk items but need artifacts for attestations (logs, configs, contracts).
- Vendor reviews: CloudKey (KMS), Logflow (logging), AuditSafe (external audit scoping).

Today (2026-03-05) high-priority:
- Finalize CloudKey access matrix evidence (priors: Priya) - ask for export of key rotation logs (deadline 3/06).
- Pull last 90 days of logging retention policy + logs for customer-sensitive endpoints (Samira) - ticket JIRA-SEC-2145 assigned.
- Confirm encryption-at-rest proof for Dedicated env (Liam) - need disk-level cipher + KMS CMK ARN.

Evidence checklist (quick status):
- [ ] CloudKey key rotation logs (owner: Priya) - asked vendor 3/04, vendor said export by 3/06.
- [x] Vendor contracts signed (CloudKey, Logflow) - stored in Confluence attach vault.
- [ ] Log retention policy doc + sample logs (owner: Samira) - partial export available, need sampling filter to show PII redaction.
- [ ] Dedicated env disk encryption proof (owner: Liam) - awaiting disk-level config screenshot + CMK ARN.
- [ ] Employee access review (owner: Jordan) - need last quarterly review CSV (HR).
- [ ] Change management tickets for inference runtime (owner: me) - draft PR and change-review note.

Vendor review notes:
- CloudKey (KMS): "OK overall" but asking for stronger rotation evidence. Follow up items: request rotation audit CSV, ask whether HSM-backed CMKs for Dedicated customers (Liam to confirm).
- Logflow (logging): retention policy OK; need sample logs showing redaction rules for user prompt/response pipeline. Samira to prod internal logging team and provide redacted sample.
- AuditSafe: scoping call 3/09 - decide whether they will do SOC2 readiness or gap analysis first. Bring notes to leadership.

Meet notes - SOC2 sync 2026-03-04:
- Agreed: focus on evidence that maps directly to common criteria first (access, encryption, change mgmt).
- Decision: can use redacted production logs for evidence if we maintain redaction proof and export steps.
- Blocker: vendor exports often come in CSVs with inconsistent timezones - normalize to UTC and include transformation script.

Immediate action items (my TODOs):
- [ ] Create JIRA ticket for rotation logs normalization + transformation script (estimate 4h).
- [ ] Draft change management doc for runtime changes (PR template + reviewers).
- [ ] Email Priya and push CloudKey export target (cc: vendor).
- [ ] Collect sample redacted logs from Samira and verify fields removed.

Nice-to-have / stretch:
- Generate automated evidence bundle script to zip artifacts + manifest (longer-term; prototype by end of sprint).
- Add small how-to in Confluence for "How we produce redacted log samples for audits".

Notes to self:
- Keep everything UTC; include screenshots with timestamps and filenames.
- Save linked artifacts into Confluence page CONFLUENCE-SOC2-EVIDENCE-2026 with a manifest.
- When vendor provides CSVs, immediately snapshot raw + normalized version and upload both.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Does Dedicated contract require separate KMS proof per-customer? (ask legal/solutions).
- Do we have a canonical place to store vendor SOC2 reports? (if not, create a restricted Confluence folder).

End-of-day plan:
- Lock tickets and owners for the items above; ensure deadlines: CloudKey 3/06, logs 3/08, Dedicated encryption 3/07.
- Quick sync with Priya at 11am PT to confirm vendor export timeline.
